name: Guide
tip: Quick guide: what each view and control does.

name: Settings
tip: Info bubbles and eco mode.

name: About & Support
tip: About Studio 87, privacy, and ways to support the project.

name: Test signal
tip: Pick what the preview rig plays into the plugin. 'Your file' uses the file you loaded.

name: Play
tip: Start or stop the test signal. Shortcut: Space.

name: Load file
tip: Load your own audio file (wav, mp3, flac, ogg). It stays in this browser tab and is never uploaded.

name: Input trim
tip: Level into the plugin, like the gain of the track in your DAW. Factory presets expect the input to peak around -6 dB (see the marker on the meter). Double-click resets.

name: Compare: bypass
tip: Hear the unprocessed signal at the same moment, to judge what the plugin adds. This is the preview rig, not a plugin control.

name: BPM 150
tip: Tempo the plugin gets from the host. The pattern gain follows it.

name: Bands
tip: Spectrum before (grey line) and after (colour fill) with draggable crossover lines and the gain reduction of every band. Shortcut: 1.

name: Curve
tip: Compressor curve of the selected band: input on the bottom, output up the side. Drag the corner to set the threshold and the end to set the ratio. Shortcut: 2.

name: Band scope
tip: Waveform of the selected band: red is the original, green is after compression, grey is where they overlap. Shortcut: 3.

name: GR history
tip: Gain reduction history of every band and the master limiter. Shortcut: 4.

name: Pattern
tip: Pattern gain: draw a rhythmic volume pattern over 16 steps. Shortcut: 5.

name: Bands
tip: How many bands the signal is split into. Drag the white crossover lines in the display to move them.

name: Crossover slope
tip: Steepness of the crossover filters. Steeper keeps the bands cleaner. The plugin offers 6 to 96 dB/oct; 36 or 48 is a good start.

name: Whole ratios
tip: Snaps every ratio to whole numbers (2:1, 3:1, 4:1 ...).

name: S
tip: Solo: hear only this band (and any other soloed band).

name: M
tip: Mute: silence this band.

name: Input
tip: Level into this band's compressor. Double-click resets.

name: Thresh
tip: Level above which the band is compressed. Also draggable on the Curve view. Double-click resets.

name: Ratio
tip: How strongly the signal above the threshold is reduced. 'inf' makes it a limiter. Also draggable on the Curve view. Double-click resets.

name: Attack
tip: How fast the compressor reacts. Short grabs transients, long lets punch through. Double-click resets.

name: Release
tip: How fast the gain comes back. With Auto on, it follows the gain reduction: more reduction, slower release. Double-click resets.

name: Boost
tip: Extra makeup gain after the compressor, on top of the automatic gain. Double-click resets.

name: Limit
tip: Ceiling of this band's limiter (ratio infinity). Mockup limiter has no lookahead; the plugin will. Double-click resets.

name: Lim rel
tip: Release of this band's limiter. Double-click resets.

name: Output
tip: Level of this band after the limiter. Use it to rebalance the bands. Double-click resets.

name: Sat
tip: Soft saturation of this band after the limiter (antialiased tanh). Drive and mix rise together. Warms bass and thickens leads. Double-click resets.

name: Width
tip: Stereo width of this band (mid/side). 0 makes the band mono: set the low band to 0 for a mono bass. 100 is unchanged. Double-click resets.

name: Comp
tip: Turns this band's compressor on or off. The band still passes through.

name: Auto rel
tip: Release follows the gain reduction. The Release knob is ignored.

name: Soft knee
tip: Soft knee eases into compression around the threshold. Off is a hard knee.

name: Limiter
tip: Turns this band's limiter on or off.

name: Mix
tip: Dry/wet of the whole plugin. 100 % is wet only. Around 75 % brings back dynamic peaks without losing much density (parallel compression). Default 50 %. Double-click resets.

name: Output
tip: Level into the master limiter. Double-click resets.

name: Post gain
tip: Level after the master limiter. Double-click resets.

name: Mstr rel
tip: Release of the master output limiter. Double-click resets.

name: Master limiter
tip: Safety limiter at the very end, after the mix, so peaks of the dry part are caught too. Ceiling -0.3 dB.

name: Autogain
tip: Compressors add makeup gain automatically so loudness stays about the same when you compress harder.
